Lemma
[pole $\Rightarrow $ diffeomorphism]

↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-1-assembly ↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-4-pullback-metric ↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-expmap-global

1. ch7:3.4Let $M$ be a complete, simply connected Riemannian manifold, $p\in M$, and $f:T_pM\to M$ a smooth local diffeomorphism which is metric-expanding for its own pulled-back metric $f^*g$. If the radial lines $s\mapsto sv$ of $T_pM$ are geodesics of $f^*g$, then $f$ is a diffeomorphism $T_pM\to M$.
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-1-assembly ↗ lem:dc-ch7-3-4-pullback-metric \sketch Equip $T_pM$ with $f^*g$. The radial lines are complete geodesics through the origin, so the source is complete at that point; the assembly lemma then makes the metric-preserving local diffeomorphism $f$ a diffeomorphism.

□
